svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 290 x 150 mm of 3 mm sheet; the long side runs up the slope.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lip bolts: four 4.5 mm holes 6 mm in from each short end, 50 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of the centre line (they go through the panel's lip).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clip screws: four 5.5 mm holes, 51 mm each side of the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 15 and 30 mm below the middle (toward the low edge).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two lightening windows 90 x 90 mm, 6 mm corners, centred 85 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of the middle along the long side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lanyard hole 6 mm on the middle line, 12 mm in from one long edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the panel's frame lip sits on the plate's ends; M4 bolts with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the nuts inside the frame. The upper clips go underneath.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the panel lip holes line up with the plate's end holes.
